events.description: Jill Goodacre says Jill Goodacre is asking Chandler Bing if Chandler Bing would like some gum.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is asking whether the gum that Jill Goodacre offered is sugarless.
Jill Goodacre says the gum that Jill Goodacre offered to Chandler Bing is not sugarless.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing just refused Jill Goodacre's offer of gum, and that refusal was baffling.
Chandler Bing says that in the future Jill Goodacre might offer gum to Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing plans to take the gum if Jill Goodacre offers gum to Chandler Bing in the future.
Chandler Bing says that in the future Jill Goodacre might offer a mangled animal carcass to Chandler Bing.
